categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes .github/workflows/ci.yml to separate macOS arm64 cross-compilation and add a native runner execution job.
categories.rationale: Cross-compiled macOS arm64 binaries were built in CI but never executed, allowing runtime segfaults like #35771 to pass undetected. Adding native runner testing for release-like cross builds closes a substantial gap in supported-platform CI validation.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests and adds native execution of test_bitcoin and test_bitcoin-qt for macOS arm64 cross builds.
categories.rationale: The change establishes test execution for macOS arm64 cross builds that previously received zero runtime test coverage. This directly prevents undetected test crashes like the segfault in #35771.
